articles.title: RBI raises share of domestically held gold reserves, data shows
articles.summary: As of September, the Reserve Bank of India has expanded its domestic gold reserves to 880.52 metric tonnes. This figure comprises 740.13 metric tonnes held in the country and 140.39 metric tonnes stored internationally. However, the proportion of gold within the overall reserves has declined to 14.38%. Currently, India's total foreign exchange reserves stand at $705.3 billion, predominantly invested in foreign government securities.

articles.title: Supreme Court nixes Allahabad high court order for Rahul Gandhi’s assets probe
articles.summary: Supreme Court has quashed an order from the Allahabad high court to investigate Rahul Gandhi's assets. The high court did not consider Gandhi's response before issuing the order, which raised procedural concerns. articles.title: India's wheat area set for steepest decline in 26 years as farmers switch crops
articles.summary: India is experiencing its most severe decline in wheat acreage in 26 years due to insufficient monsoon rains.
